pwb_callouts.sub: LED pads 0.10 from the cutout edge by design (note 8)

fab_notes: 1. Material: FR-4, 1.6 mm, 2 layers, JLCPCB standard (sheet 1 table).
2. Copper: 1 oz both sides. Surface finish: lead-free HASL.
3. Solder mask black, silkscreen white, both sides. Vias tented.
4. Fabricate to IPC-6012 Class 2. Electrical test 100 %.
5. Dimensions in mm. Tolerances unless noted: outline ±0.2, finished holes ±0.08.
6. Fabricate from the Gerber and drill files of the same revision as this drawing.
7. Minimum trace width 0.20 mm. Smallest hole Ø0.30 (vias) on Ø0.61 pads: 0.15 mm annular ring.
8. 25 routed LED cutouts, 3.60 × 3.20 mm. The LED pads sit 0.10 mm from the cutout edge by design (SK6812MINI-EA reverse mount); keep the pads full size.
9. The 5 plated mounting holes (M1–M5) are not connected to any net; keep them isolated on both layers.
10. No controlled impedance, slots (other than the LED cutouts), castellations, edge plating or gold fingers.
bom_notes: 1. INSTALLED BY: JLCPCB = fitted by the JLCPCB assemblers (SMT and through-hole) before delivery; After delivery = fitted by the builder.
2. PROCESS gives the assembly process and the side the part is on.
3. The key switches (SW1–SW25) are self-sourced and soldered after delivery; they are not in the EasyEDA BOM.
4. The keycaps (90000001) are fitted at module level, see KC-01-2710.
5. Substitutes need the approval of the design authority.

bom_extra.desc: Key switch, Kailh Choc V1 White, clicky, low profile

place_notes: 1. All SMT parts and CN1 are on the bottom side. The key switches SW1–SW25 are the only top-side parts.
2. The bottom view is drawn as seen holding the board bottom side up (flipped left to right), so the datum is at the top right.
3. Red dot = pin 1: every LED and CN1, the cathode of each diode D1–D25, and the + terminal of C1. These match the silkscreen marks.
4. The LEDs mount reverse, body through the cutout, so they light the switch from below.
5. Part centres, rotations and part numbers are in the placement table (last sheet), measured from the datum (top view).
corner_note: Outer corners R4.23 (4 places), notch corners R3.00 (3 places)

assy_parts.name: Keycap - MBK, custom legend
assy_parts.desc: MBK low-profile keycap for Kailh Choc V1 with a custom legend for its key position (FKcaps); legends per Expansion Module spec §7 and E-17

assy_notes: 1. Item 1 is the KC-01-2712 card as assembled by JLCPCB to KC-01-2711 to KC-01-2714.
2. Solder the key switches (item 2) into SW1–SW25 on the top of the card after delivery; the LEDs light them through the cutouts.
3. Fit a keycap (item 3, 90000001) to each switch in its legend position. The views show a placeholder key top.
4. Orthographic views at 4:3 on A3; isometric views not to scale. Parts list on sheet 2.
